title: Lane lint picks a folder-scan suite when a new file lands in its folder
why: Suites that scan one folder (workflows for test_ci_job, agents, hooks/guard*.py) are not picked for a new file there, so a defect in a new file passes lane lint and goes red in batch CI (debt lane-lint-folder-scans-unpicked on #2120).
note: Filed 10:46 CST Nov 8 from lane lane-lint-cloud-time-limit (session_013NEJL1PUcS4Dxhd9Rr1sk2). Under item 386 it rides in that lane unless off topic. Related: lane-lint-tree-scan-picked (#2120).
